name: linkleads
description: LinkLeads — app desktop de prospecção B2B com automação de ritmo humano, multi-conta e CRM local.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/db packages/ai && npm run typecheck -w @linkleads/desktop
scripts.e2e: npm run build && xvfb-run -a node apps/desktop/e2e/run.mjs && xvfb-run -a node apps/desktop/e2e/sequence.mjs && xvfb-run -a node apps/desktop/e2e/decision.mjs
